info.title: CNGOKZAPI
info.description:
API of the CNGOKZAPI platform for the CS:GO / CS2 KZ community.

All endpoints are versioned under `/api/v1` (except health probes and documentation). Successful responses use the `{ success, data, message }` envelope, failures use `{ success, error, message }` with a proper HTTP status code.

get.description: Anonymous callers receive `200` with `authenticated: false` so the SPA can render the logged-out state without a failed request.
Verifies the assertion with Steam, creates the account when needed and sets the session cookie. Failures redirect back to the site with `?auth_error=<code>`.

post.description: Authenticated with `X-Server-Token`. The API records its own receive time and derives ONLINE/STALE from it.
Missing players are marked disconnected only on this server; sessions on other servers are untouched.
Idempotent on (`server_id`, `record_identifier`). PB/WR/points are decided by the API and phase-6 triggers, never by the plugin.
The replay bytes stay in R2/S3. Registration is idempotent on (bucket, object_key); a failed upload leaves the record valid and creates a retryable sync task.

items.description:
A current world record with optional historical improvement fields.

`previous_time_ns` / `improvement_ns` are always `null` in phase 4 because the
schema does not store WR transition history.
